title: Missing San Juan County teen found, police say - NewsBreak
text:
By Ryan Bittan ,
12 hours ago
Update 4/8/26, 2:01 p.m. SAN JUAN COUNTY, Utah ( ABC4 ) — Ethan Brown, 15, has been found safe, according to the San Juan County Sheriff’s Office.
Brown was found today at approximately 10:30 a.m. in the Albuquerque, New Mexico, area, the sheriff’s office said in an update Wednesday afternoon. San Juan County Sheriff Lacy is currently bringing him back home.
“We want to sincerely thank everyone in the community & general public who called in and reported possible sightings and information. Your support was invaluable,” the sheriff’s office added. “We also want to thank all the agencies and everyone who assisted us in this case. A special shout out to Regan Richmond, who was able to fly the Sheriff down to pick up Ethan. We are grateful and happy to report that Ethan was found healthy and well.”
No further information is available at this time.
Original Post SAN JUAN COUNTY, Utah ( ABC4 ) — New information has been released on a 15-year-old San Juan County boy who has been missing for over a week.
In an update Wednesday morning, the San Juan County Sheriff’s Office said they have found the vehicle that Ethan Brown, 15, reportedly entered on April 1. Brown reportedly got in the vehicle, a white Dodge Ram 3500 dually pickup truck, shortly before 8:30 a.m. at a Maverik gas station in Monticello, Utah.
Video footage shows the truck pulling a Solitude fifth-wheel camper, the sheriff’s office said. The truck reportedly also has a distinctive large push bumper, a heavy-duty steel or aluminum frame mounted to the front of the vehicle.
READ: Boy, 15, missing out of San Juan County for over a week “Unfortunately, we are unable to view the vehicle’s license plate due to obstructions and camera angles,” the sheriff’s office said.
There were two individuals in the truck, pictured below:
First person of interest in case of missing San Juan County teen. (Courtesy: San Juan County Sheriff’s Office)
Second person of interest in case of missing San Juan County teen. (Courtesy: San Juan County Sheriff’s Office)
After leaving the Monticello Maverik, the vehicle headed east on US 491 toward Colorado, the sheriff’s office said.
In the video footage obtained at the gas station, Brown reportedly did not appear to be in distress. He appeared to speak with these individuals prior to entering the vehicle and got in voluntarily.
The truck and trailer are pictured below:
White Dodge Ram 3500 dually pickup truck pulling a Solitude fifth-wheel camper, reportedly involved in the case of missing San Juan County teen, Ethan Brown. (Courtesy: San Juan County Sheriff’s Office)
“If you recognize these individuals, have seen this vehicle and camper trailer, or are one of the individuals pictured, please contact the San Juan County Sheriff’s Office at 435-587-2237 or call 911 to report any information,” the update states. “We would like to speak to the individuals in the pictures to determine where they took Ethan.”
An additional picture of the couple is featured below:
Persons of interest in case of missing San Juan County teen. (Courtesy: San Juan County Sheriff’s Office) No further information is available at this time.
